name: Jesus As Image Of God
overview: The Scriptures reveal Jesus as the perfect and divine image of God, fully united with the Father in essence and purpose. John 1 affirms that Jesus, the Word, was both with God and was God from the beginning, and as the only begotten Son, He uniquely reveals the unseen Father to humanity. Jesus Himself declares that He acts only as He sees the Father act, demonstrating complete harmony and oneness with God (John 5:19; 10:30). Through His life, teaching, and sacrifice, Jesus reveals God's nature and offers eternal life to all who believe in Him (John 3:16; 8:28).
